worktrees.description: Worktrees of the project, or of all projects when none is named or found by the directory: by project, the main worktree first, then by path.

path.description: Absolute path of the worktree root.

project.description: Identifier of the project whose pool has the worktree.

main.description: Whether this is the main worktree of the project.

branch.description: Branch checked out in the worktree, read from git at the call; absent when the worktree is not on a branch or its directory does not exist.
